subject: danish
summary: Danish is one of the better-looking of this group. Text renders correctly (æ, ø, å), the right article is attached to every reading card with no other questions on it, and the schemes answer the question asked, with a mark badge on each row. The five-word vocabulary card labels each answer with its word ('For “uldtrøje”') at 1 mark each, and the essay card shows the four official criteria with their percentages and a small score picker per criterion, which is far better than the 'no answer' essay cards in other languages. Remaining faults: the grey language-rule note under answers, a question that repeats the same sentence five times with stray spaces in the quotation marks, long sample answers in one box, and a footer strip that shows a meaningless tail fragment.

issues.title: Grey language-rule note under answers
issues.detail: 'The examination requires every answer in DANISH. The paper prints the rule on page 2: "Alle svar skal skrives på dansk."' is appended to the first scheme row of every card; on card 4 it is glued to the label as 'For “englebamse”: The examination requires...'. On card 3 it expands to five lines including 'The scheme prints this paragraph under “Opgave III” and names neither title.'
issues.suggested_fix: Remove from cards; state once at subject level.

issues.title: Five-part question repeats the full sentence five times
issues.detail: Card 4 prints 'Forklar betydningen af ordet ”…” som det bruges i teksten' five times with no (a)-(e) letters, no full stops, and stray spaces after the opening quote (” genbrug”, ” fortørnede”, ” vendepunkt”); on the phone the quote mark is orphaned at a line end.
issues.suggested_fix: One instruction line, then a lettered list of the five words; trim the spaces.

issues.title: Sample answer in a single all-or-nothing box
issues.detail: Cards 1 and 2 show the expected answer as one paragraph (22 lines on the phone for card 2) with a single 5m badge, so there is no way to claim part of it.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into the 2-3 ideas (how politicians communicate / positive / negative) as separate rows.

issues.title: Footer strip shows a meaningless fragment
issues.detail: Card 1's grey strip reads 'Not claimed yet · 5 marks · ikke en sikker gevinst.' (the last four words of the answer). Card 4's strip is three truncated copies of 'Enhver rimelig forklaring (e.g. ...' plus 'and 2 more'.
issues.suggested_fix: Show just the marks outstanding, or the first words of the point, never the tail.

issues.title: Essay guidance covers only one of the two titles
issues.detail: Card 3 shows both essay titles but the bold guidance paragraph is about the first (material vs spiritual happiness) only, and nothing says so except a grey aside. The Lincoln quotation and its attribution run on with a stray ' - '.
issues.suggested_fix: Label the guidance with the title it belongs to; set the two titles as a list (a)/(b).

good_examples.why: Essay scheme with the four criteria, their weightings and a per-criterion score picker: the model for essay cards in the other languages.
Each vocabulary answer is labelled with its word and carries 1 mark.
Compact single-part card with paragraph reference and the right text attached.
